Admin routes of the reviews module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/reviews

List reviews (admin)

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `productId` in query (string, optional).
- `rating` in query (number, min 1, max 5, optional).
- `userId` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Reviews retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/reviews/{id}

Delete review (admin)

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Review deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Review not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/reviews/{id}

Update review (admin)

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [AdminUpdateReviewDto](#adminupdatereviewdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Review updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Review not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/reviews/{id}/approve

Approve review

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Review approved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Review not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/reviews/{id}/reject

Reject review

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [ModerateReviewDto](#moderatereviewdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Review rejected.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Review not found.

## Schemas

### AdminUpdateReviewDto

- `rating` (number, min 1, max 5, optional).
- `title` (string, max length 200, optional).
- `body` (string, max length 5000, optional).
- `assetIds` (array of string, optional).
- `status` (object, optional).
- `reason` (string, max length 1000, optional).

### ModerateReviewDto

- `reason` (string, max length 1000, optional).
